scope: All enumerated repository worktrees: committed candidate plus supplemental commit refs, source/config/doc working changes; selected external run source scripts. This is a point-in-time capture, not a live mirror.
working_tree_policy: Working bytes preserved without touching source indexes or creating source commits. Deletions/renames recorded. Duplicate path+content points to one copy. No WIP applied to candidate.
exclusions: Model weights, user projects/database, credentials, runtime caches, generated reports/media and raw agent logs are excluded from NEW snapshots. Historical tracked test fixtures remain in Git.
